about: Mail vendors (MailProviders). A new vendor is a new entry here, not new code. kind: graph (Microsoft Graph) or imap. signIn: microsoft (Sign in with Microsoft: audience organizations or consumers), microsoft_app (an app's tenant id, client id and client secret), app_password or password (saved in the vault). domains: addresses at these domains are this vendor. mx: a company domain whose mail servers (MX) end with one of these is this vendor. regions: the vendor's data centres, each with its own server.

providers.name: Microsoft 365
providers.help: Sign in with the mailbox's Microsoft account, or with one that may read the shared mailbox.

providers.name: Outlook.com, Hotmail
providers.help: A personal Microsoft account: sign in with Microsoft.

providers.name: Exchange on your servers
providers.help: Exchange Server with IMAP turned on: give its address. The password is saved in the vault.

providers.name: Gmail, Google Workspace
providers.help: Google needs an app password for mail programs: turn on 2-step verification, then make one. A Google Workspace administrator may have to allow app passwords and IMAP.

providers.name: Zoho Mail
providers.help: Turn on IMAP in Zoho Mail's settings. With two-factor sign-in, make an app password in Zoho Accounts > Security > App passwords.

providers.name: Yahoo Mail
providers.help: Yahoo needs an app password for mail programs: Account security > Generate app password.

providers.name: AOL Mail
providers.help: AOL needs an app password for mail programs: Account security > Generate app password.

providers.name: iCloud Mail
providers.help: Apple needs an app-specific password: Apple Account > Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords.

providers.name: GMX
providers.help: Turn on access by mail programs (POP3/IMAP) in GMX's settings first.

providers.name: Fastmail
providers.help: Make an app password in Fastmail: Settings > Privacy & Security > Integrations (Manage app passwords).

providers.name: Rediffmail
providers.help: Turn on IMAP access in Rediffmail's settings.

providers.name: Other mail server
providers.help: Any mail server with IMAP: its address, port 993 with SSL/TLS (or 143 without, on a trusted network only), and the password saved in the vault.
